Class DiffResult

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.buffer.DiffResult
public final class DiffResult extends Object
A reusable, allocation-free container for buffer diff results.

Changed cells are stored as runs: pairs of (startIndex, length) over the row-major cell index of the target buffer. Consecutive changed cells collapse into one run, so a backend can position the cursor once per run and stream the cells; the cells themselves are read straight from the target buffer, so nothing per cell is copied or referenced here.

Typical usage pattern: 

DiffResult diff = new DiffResult(1920);  // Pre-size for 80x24 terminal
while (running) {
    previousBuffer.diff(currentBuffer, diff);
    backend.draw(diff);
    diff.clear();
}

  • Constructor Details

    • DiffResult

      public DiffResult()
      Creates a new diff result with the default initial capacity (256 updates).

    • DiffResult

      public DiffResult(int initialCapacity)
      Creates a new diff result sized for the given number of changed cells.

      The worst case (every other cell changed) needs one run per two cells, so sizing this to the terminal cell count guarantees no reallocation.

      Parameters:
      initialCapacity - the expected maximum number of changed cells per frame

    • getX

      public int getX(int i)
      Returns the x coordinate of the i-th changed cell.

      This is an index-based view over the runs and costs O(runCount()) per call. Backends should iterate runs with runStart(int)/runLength(int) instead.

      Parameters:
      i - the index of the changed cell (0 to size()-1)
      Returns:
      the x coordinate
